content:
STAGE: read the five frozen bundles and locate the binding quantitative evidence.
GOAL: decide which proposals can actually move Stage3 test_recall@10 on this evidence, before ranking.
READ: bundles 422ac3c7 (GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ), 7a105a8c (HEXSWAP-SID), 1a570bc7 (HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR), d3e91cc5 (ADM-GEO-RQ), b97d402a (TAUSWAP), all rubric rank-2026-10-v1. Same observed block E4-E11 in every bundle; only E12/E13 (geometry) differ.
OBSERVED (E6, width-20 beams, 57439 test rows): l1_br recall@10 0.04671 with gold-prefix-alive at depth 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 (1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085); l1_only 0.06233 (1.000/0.829/0.156/0.086); resample 0.06363 (0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088); successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500; successor_entropy 0.05122. No arm reaches the 0.065 target.
OBSERVED (E7): l1_br teacher-forced NLL T1/T2/T3/T4 = 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03, i.e. the whole residual loss sits at the last token in that arm; l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23.
OBSERVED (E8): share of positive pairs sharing a level-1 cluster at K=256 is only 0.0822 vs 0.0129 for negatives, and the bundle itself says small K is what width-20 prefix survival depends on.
OBSERVED (E11): baseline same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 (diagnostic, explicitly not a gate).
REASONING: three consequences. (i) The measured bottleneck is the deepest token, not the first: depth-1 survival is 1.000 in three arms while depth-4 survival is 0.068-0.088 and caps recall. (ii) Curved metrics placed inside the assignment step are the one family that has already been measured here and it is worse than its Euclidean twin (0.055 vs 0.062), so ADM-GEO-RQ carries direct negative evidence even though it reaches every level. (iii) All three level-1 exchange mechanisms (GROMOVSWAP, HEXSWAP, TAUSWAP) preserve the 256-cell level-1 partition and therefore cannot raise depth-1 survival above the 1.000 already observed, and can only reshuffle a signal whose same-prefix rate is barely above the permutation null; their headroom is structurally small.
OPEN: ordering of the three level-1 exchange variants among themselves, and of ADM-GEO relative to them.

STAGE: place the five proposals against E6/E7/E8/E11 and against each proposal's own geometry clause (E12/E13 in its bundle).
READ: the five SPECIFICATION blocks plus each bundle's E12/E13.
OBSERVED, per proposal:
- HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR: mutable object is the LAST RQ code only; levels 1..L-1 bit-identical; score q_behaviour(k')*exp(-d_kappa(v_i,c_k)) with v_i a gyromidpoint of the item with its behaviour neighbours at a prefix anchor, fixed kappa=1 with scale s=7.6/max||r|| derived from artanh(1-1e-3); zero added Stage-2 steps, one post-epoch-3000 pass.
- ADM-GEO-RQ: Poincare dP (K=1) inside the argmin at EVERY level of EVERY Stage-2 step, gated by a behaviour-disjointness veto dX<=0 plus travel budget lambda_l*max(0,sbar-tau); straight-through gradient stays Euclidean; churn 3-15% claimed.
- HEXSWAP-SID: post-hoc level-1 exchanges only; move set restricted to items where Lorentz nearest codeword disagrees with the Euclidean assignment; K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) measured from the train transition graph; cardinality preserved; admits in its own risks that the disagreement set may be empty (geometry no-op).
- TAUSWAP: post-hoc level-1 1-for-1 exchanges; gain from Poincare distance to cell Karcher means; kappa=1 is a documented default, not measured; admits gains near the ball origin may rank almost identically to Euclidean; Delta-R half may reject every swap; h0 from an internal holdout (deleting each user's last transition) is the cleanest leakage control of the five.
- GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ: per-epoch level-1 swaps from epoch 300; Gromov delta_hat enters only as a thin-triangle CERTIFICATE and the accept rule is dS<0 and dD<=0 on integer behaviour counts, so with the certificate removed and Euclidean cell means substituted the same swaps are largely generated: geometry is a gate, not the driver. Adds 3-8% wall clock and perturbs the partition every epoch.
REASONING: HYP-CERT first because it is the only proposal aimed at the coordinate where E6/E7 localise the loss, and its behaviour and geometry terms are multiplied inside one score so either removal changes ranking. ADM-GEO second: only other mechanism that can reach the depth-4 collapse, but E6's successor_geodesic/tangent arms (0.055/0.055) already show a curved assignment step losing ~0.007 to its Euclidean twin. HEXSWAP third: geometry is load-bearing (it builds the candidate set) and K is measured, but it preserves the 1.000 depth-1 partition and is self-declared no-op-prone. TAUSWAP fourth: same level-1 ceiling, kappa=1 not derived, gain may be near-Euclidean, but its holdout-based h0 and explicit ledgers are sound. GROMOVSWAP last: level-1 only AND per-epoch perturbation AND the weakest coupling (removable certificate), which is exactly the "geometry name without geometric computation" failure mode the scope warns about.
OPEN: none; the single-run/no-ablation policy means each ranked candidate is judged on this evidence only, and no arm can be run to break a tie.

STAGE: final answer delivered (ranking, best first).
ANSWER:
RANK: HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 put the loss at the deepest token (gold prefix alive depths 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068 in l1_br, T4 NLL 9.03) and this is the only proposal that repairs the last code while keeping levels 1..L-1 bit-identical, with behaviour and Poincare distance multiplied in one score q_behaviour*exp(-d_kappa(v_i,c_k)) at zero added Stage-2 cost.
RANK: ADM-GEO-RQ | position=2 | reason=the only other mechanism whose action reaches the depth-4 collapse because it alters assignment at every level every step, but E6 already shows curved assignment losing to its Euclidean twin (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207), so it is placed second, not first.
RANK: HEXSWAP-SID | position=3 | reason=geometry is load-bearing (Lorentz-vs-Euclidean disagreement defines the candidate set) with K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) measured and cardinality preserved, but it preserves a level-1 partition whose depth-1 survival is already 1.000 in E6 and whose same-prefix signal is 0.0907 vs a 0.067 permutation null in E11, and it flags its own empty-disagreement no-op risk.
RANK: TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE | position=4 | reason=same level-1 ceiling as HEXSWAP (E6 depth-1 alive 1.000, E11 weak first-prefix signal), kappa=1 is a documented default rather than a measured quantity, and it concedes near-origin gains may rank almost identically to Euclidean; only its internal-holdout h0 and explicit Delta-D/Delta-R ledgers are stronger.
RANK: GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ | position=5 | reason=level-1 only in a regime where E6 shows depth-1 is never the bottleneck, plus per-epoch perturbation and the weakest coupling: delta_hat is only a certificate while the accept rule dS<0/dD<=0 is pure behaviour counting, so with the geometry gate removed the same swaps largely survive, and E8's K=256 positive-share ceiling of 0.0822 bounds what level-1 reshuffling can buy.
NOTE: positions are 1..5 with no ties; no ablation arm was assumed anywhere, every reason above cites the frozen bundle only.
